findings: Privacy sheet secondary button ('Switch to Local AI') calls Navigator.pop without setting _privacyDisclaimerShown=true or writing to DB — user will see the sheet again on next send if they dismiss this way. Non-blocking but should be a conscious decision.

Export & Backup tile routes to ProfileScreen(), not a dedicated export screen. Subtitle promises 'CSV export · JSON backup · Restore' but user lands on the full profile page. Non-blocking if no dedicated screen exists yet.
